decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR states the subject and the change. Before, the error returned by the traefik command (for example a failure to bind an entryPoint listener) was logged at DBG through the stdlib logger. Now it is logged at ERR as "Command error" from cmd/traefik/traefik.go [ev-812df9816c58][ev-40d631cd91e7][ev-e42b47325a13]. The motivation it gives also answers applicability and consequence: any deployment whose log level is above DEBUG and whose traefik command errors at launch will now see this error in its logs, where before it was hidden [ev-812df9816c58]. P1's claim that the previous level is unknown is contradicted by the before/after comparison in the PR, so applicability can be written from this evidence.
